Computer Science BSc at University of St Andrews

What University of St Andrews asks of applicants to Computer Science BSc for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

UK · All University of St Andrews courses · Computer Science field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 5 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • For applicants with a US high-school diploma:
    • SAT and ACT are test-optional for September 2027 (and September 2028) entry
    • applicants are not penalised for not submitting a score
  • If submitted, St Andrews looks for SAT 1320+ or ACT 28+ (both superscored)
Verified19 Oct 2026St Andrews: USA entry requirements
English language
  • English language profile 7-D (Faculty of Science)
  • IELTS Academic (incl. One Skill Retake) or IELTS Online: 6.5 overall with 6.0 in each component
  • TOEFL iBT:
    • 4.5 overall with 4.0 in each section (2026 onwards)
    • 81 overall with Reading 16, Writing 19, Listening 16, Speaking 19 (pre-2026)
  • Cambridge English:
    • 176 overall, 169 in each component
    • PTE Academic: 70 overall, 64 in each
    • Duolingo: 130 overall, 115 in each
    • Oxford ELLT Digital: 8 overall, 7 in each
  • Test scores are normally accepted only if obtained within two years of the programme start date; no test is needed by UK/majority-English-speaking nationals or holders of a qualifying English-medium school-leaving qualification
Verified19 Oct 2026St Andrews: English language requirements for undergraduate students · St Andrews: English language profile 7-D (Science)
Admissions tests

None listed on the official source

St Andrews names the UCAT (for Medicine) as its only admissions test.

Verified19 Oct 2026St Andrews: Academic entry explained
Subject prerequisites
  • Required: Mathematics at A (A-Level) or HL6 (IB), plus a pass in one of Biology, Chemistry, Computing Science, Further Mathematics, Geology, Geography, Physics or Psychology (IB: SL5 in a listed science)
  • No previous knowledge of computer science is required

A pass in one of a listed set of subjects (Further Mathematics is one option) is also required; the engine cannot express the one-of choice.

Other qualifications
  • For applicants with a US high-school diploma: A or B grades in honours-level courses, or three AP subjects with scores of 4+, judged in the context of the school’s rigour
  • Computer Science: subject-specific pre-requisites may apply — St Andrews gives “AP Calculus BC” at 5 as an example for Computer Science
  • AP scores are used for admissions only; no credit or exemptions are awarded
Verified19 Oct 2026St Andrews: USA entry requirements
Other requirements
  • No interview: St Andrews interviews for Medicine, Gateway and Pathway programmes, part-time study and International Foundation Programmes only
  • A personal statement and a reference are required
